predecessors.name: Cao Cao
predecessors.text: the Han realm Cao Pi took in December 220: Cliopatria's Cao Cao shape of 215 without the Gongsun land and Hanzhong

predecessors.name: Han dynasty
predecessors.text: the Han realm Cao Pi took in December 220: Cliopatria's Cao Cao shape of 215 without the Gongsun land and Hanzhong

successors.name: Jin dynasty (Western and Eastern Jin)
successors.text: the whole Wei realm with Shu, passed to Sima Yan, who 'forced Cao Huan to abdicate in his favor' on 4 February 266

ledger.x: 220: Cao Pi founds the Wei.
221: Sun Quan becomes King of Wu under Wei.
222: Wei attacks Wu.
222: Sun Quan breaks with Wei.
223: the Dongkou and Jiangling battles end without a change of frontier.
224: the Western Regions as a Wei dependency.
226: the capital moves from Xuchang to Luoyang.
228: Gongsun Yuan holds Liaodong under Wei.
228: Zhuge Liang's northern expeditions begin.
228: the battle of Shiting on the Wu front, listed among the Wei-Wu battles (Dongkou 222-223, Jiangling 223, Shiting 228).
228: Shiting ends without a change of frontier.
234: Zhuge Liang dies at the Wuzhang Plains and the expeditions end.
237: Gongsun Yuan rebels.
238: Sima Yi marches on Liaodong.
238: Wei takes Liaodong and northwest Korea.
September 238: Xiangping falls; the Zizhi Tongjian places the fall on 19 September 238 (footnote).
244: Wei reaches Hwando.
245: Guanqiu Jian's raid ends; Wei holds no Goguryeo land.
263: Wei invades Shu.
263: Wei conquers Shu.
December 263: the war ends with the surrender of Chengdu; Zhong Hui's mutiny at Chengdu (1-3 March 264) is the aftermath.
266: the Western Regions pass with the throne to the Western Jin, which the same page names as the office's second holder ('maintained by the Cao Wei and the Western Jin'); the year is the dynasty's.
266: Sima Yan ends the Wei.

wars.name: Wei-Wu border wars of the 220s
wars.outcome: Battles at Dongkou (222-223), Jiangling (223) and Shiting (228); no change of frontier.

wars.name: Zhuge Liang's Northern Expeditions
wars.outcome: Five Shu campaigns without lasting gain.

wars.name: Sima Yi's Liaodong campaign
wars.outcome: Gongsun Yuan's Yan is destroyed in September 238 and Liaodong and northwest Korea become Wei's.

wars.name: Goguryeo-Wei Wars
wars.outcome: Wei destroys Hwando in 244; Guanqiu Jian's raid of 244-245 leaves no Wei garrison.

wars.name: Conquest of Shu by Wei
wars.outcome: Shu is annexed; Wu's relief attacks of January-March 264 are withdrawn.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a border.
